summary: Quiet street edge backing onto creek and bush, motorway beyond; no parking convention.
reasons: Bush and creek on both sides, homes 40 m+
Narrow lane, grass verge to east

drivers.seclusion: Bush on the west, creek and long grass on the east; nearest mapped homes 41 m or more from the south end, northern houses about 60 m off.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane with a grass verge on the east side; verge looks wide enough to pull off but trees crowd it from about 30 m.
drivers.traffic: Quiet local lane; motorway 50 m to the south-east.
drivers.convention: A couple of cars stand at the ends, but no clear parking habit along this stretch.

flags: Low-lying: about 5 m elevation, creek 6 m away
Mapped gate 69 m away has a way round it
sun_shade: Tree canopy on the west side shades the lane in the afternoon; east side open to morning sun.
cannot_judge: Whether the verge is firm enough to stand on

best_section.where: Market Street North, east edge past the last houses, before the bend towards the motorway
